Bettina, I couldn't set up the weekly digest. The scheduler rejected both my attempt to read the existing jobs and my attempt to create the new one, with the error "gateway cron requires credentials." Nothing has been scheduled, and I couldn't check for an existing digest job, so please don't assume one is running.

When it's set up, I'd plan it this way:

- **Schedule:** Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, first run Monday 19 October.
- **Sources:** #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both have the same four members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so the digest won't reveal anything outside the team.
- **Customer items:** these will leave out finance figures (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoice amounts, payment terms) and finance documents. Those go only to Anselm, June and the account owner. Operational facts like seat counts, renewal dates, licensed products, ticket numbers and meeting times will be included.

Someone with gateway admin access needs to fix the scheduler credentials. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll create the job and run one test.
